As the UEFA Conference League progresses, both Crystal Palace and Rayo Vallecano find themselves striving to improve their standings. Currently, Crystal Palace is in the top half of their domestic league, aiming for a chance at Europe next season, while Rayo Vallecano is battling to secure their position against relegation.
